all.src: IV rank >= 30 over 252 days; prefer IV rank > 50 for full size.
Directional gate: last close > 20-EMA, OR the short strike is at least 1.0 ATR(14) below the lowest low of the last 10 sessions.
Net credit >= 33% of width. A $5-wide must pay >= $1.65.
Max loss (width*100 - credit) <= 2% of equity = $1,000 on $50k; position count limited so that total defined risk across all open spreads <= 25% of equity.
Both legs OI >= 500 and bid/ask <= 10% of mid.
Both legs OI >= 500 and bid/ask <= 10% of mid.
Earnings: no entry with earnings inside the expiry unless IV rank > 60 and the short strike is beyond 1.25 * the implied move.

management.src: Take profit: close at 50% of max profit (spread mid <= 0.50 * credit).
Time exit: close at 21 DTE regardless of P/L if the profit target has not hit.
Stop: close when the spread mark = 2.0x credit received, or when the underlying closes below the short strike, whichever first.

exits.src: Hard rule: flat by 15:45 ET on expiration day, every time.
ASSIGNMENT GUARD: at 15:30 ET on expiration day, if the underlying is below (short strike + $0.05), close the whole spread immediately.

ASSIGNMENT GUARD: any day the short put is ITM with extrinsic value < $0.10, close that session. Deep ITM American puts are exercised early once extrinsic dies, especially in high-rate environments where the holder earns interest on the proceeds.
